Asteroids ahead, pilot!

Listen for the number, then tap that asteroid to blast it. Clear 8 asteroid fields to reach the space station!

For grown-ups: choose English or עברית (Hebrew counting words) and 0–10 or 0–20. The number isn't shown at the top, so she has to listen. Tap 🔊 Listen to hear it again. Wrong choices are often look-alike numbers (6 and 9, 1 and 7, 3 and 8). Asteroids never hit the ship, so there's no way to lose.
